The '''Imperial Collection Facility''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. It was a collection point for [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and civilians abducted by Imperial forces. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces allied with [[Dantaree]] assaulted the base to free the prisoners.
